items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: I got in the Dave Bartholomew's band... And I played that with Dave later.

ctx.x: for me. It just happened. I mean, you, you, you sat there, you got the books. Now how about reading?

Did you pick up reading? I read fair at, at, after six months, you're not as good as some of the guys who've been doing it all their lives. And Clyde Kersenior taught me a lot about reading. Uh, I recall that, uh, there was a situation that on my own, I was going to try to make an, write an arrangement and had no clue to how to do it. And it showed, it didn't come out good at all because I didn't know that you had to transpose the notes according to the chord progression. You know, I just thought I could take a…
him you, you, that you were at Grunwald. Yeah.
